component.name: Aura
component.summary: Animated live wallpaper manager for COSMIC Desktop

description.p: Aura is an elegant, high-performance animated live wallpaper manager built natively with Rust for the System76 COSMIC Desktop environment.
Designed to deliver immersive desktop aesthetics without compromising system efficiency, Aura integrates seamlessly into modern Wayland workflows.

ul.li: 60fps Native Performance: Built from the ground up using libcosmic and wgpu for silky-smooth rendering.
Hardware-Accelerated GPU Decoding: High-efficiency video playback keeping CPU overhead and battery drain near zero.
COSMIC Auto-Theming: Dynamically adapts UI elements and accent harmonies to system themes and wallpaper palettes.
Wayland Layer-Shell Protocol: Stutter-free wallpaper rendering docked precisely below windows across multi-monitor setups.
Intelligent Resource Throttling: Automatically pauses or throttles playback when fullscreen windows or games are active.

description.p: Aura 1.1.0 brings a major feature and usability update:

ul.li: Multi-monitor support with per-output target selection and independent wallpaper playback.
Audio volume slider (0-100%) and instant mute toggle with level memory.
Floating non-intrusive Toaster notifications overlay with zero layout shift.
User-accessible wallpapers directory (saved to ~/Pictures/Wallpapers/Aura) and direct File Manager shortcuts.
Hardware decoding backend selector (auto-safe, vaapi, nvdec).
Automated playlist wallpaper rotation with custom interval and random/sequential modes.
Laptop battery saver via UPower D-Bus and non-blocking Feral GameMode pausing.
In-app update checking and update CLI command.
Enhanced Flatpak sandbox permissions for audio, system bus, and COSMIC theming.

description.p: First official production release on Flathub and COSMIC Store. Features animated live wallpaper playback at 60 FPS, online 4K catalogs (Bing UHD and Wallhaven), COSMIC auto-theming, smart library filters, and Wayland power optimizations.

Aura 0.2.0 introduces online 4K wallpaper catalogs (Bing UHD and Wallhaven), smart library filters (Live, Static, Downloaded), deletion management from UI, CPU optimizations for static images, native Wayland auto-pause, and standard CLI flags.
Initial release of Aura live wallpaper manager for COSMIC Desktop.
